Everything of mine is committed; the untracked files belong to the two live sibling teams. Work is complete and verified.

## Summary

Made the project's stated claim match its dependency graph, and turned one of the two things the headline was "waiting on a decision" for into a proved theorem. The substantive advance: the headline leaf bundled a `k`-rational point with geometric integrality, and only one of those is a decision. Geometric integrality of a smooth proper geometrically irreducible curve follows from the challenge's own hypotheses via `Smooth ⟹ GeometricallyReduced`, so it is now proved and measured axiom-clean, leaving the rational point alone as the open owner decision.

I also got something wrong mid-session and reverted it — details under Issues.

## Progress

- `AlgebraicJacobian/Jacobian.lean`: leaf `hasRationalPoint_and_geometricallyIntegral` split into `geometricallyIntegral_of_curve` (proved, clean) and `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` (sorry, false as stated, a gap marker to be replaced not proved). Sorry count unchanged at 3 — the split moved a proof in, not a sorry out.
- `AlgebraicJacobian/Curve/GeometricallyReduced.lean`: new, ported unchanged from the sibling Rebuild project; mathlib-general, Mathlib-only imports, upstreaming candidate.
- `AlgebraicJacobian.lean`: rooted every committed module — the two rigid-pushforward modules my predecessor had to back out, plus `RigidPushforwardFrontier` and `RigidPushforwardP1ChartRing` as they landed. Headline cone 96 → 97.
- `scripts/axiom-frontier.lean`: 61 → 66 declarations. Now names all four ways a short axiom line overstates a result, each measured rather than asserted, and carries a per-declaration open-hypotheses column for cluster P at ajc-rr's request.
- `blueprint/src/chapters/Jacobian.tex`: gap node split into four nodes with complete proofs, three `\leanok`.
- `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`: strategy note no longer reads as the live route.
- README, TO_USER, campaign doc, roadmap (`AJC.jacobian.reachability` → done; three summaries rewritten).

Verification, re-run after all edits and after the sibling teams' interleaved commits: `lake build AlgebraicJacobian` green at 8733 jobs exit 0; probe 66 declarations exit 0 (41 clean, 35 carrying `sorryAx`); blueprint 620 pages, zero unresolved references; hgraph sync clean apart from 33 pre-existing pin warnings.

## Issues

- **I withdrew two blueprint `\leanok` claims and had to revert.** A fresh-context review flagged 18 more nodes with the same property, which made me check the convention instead of removing 18 more. `\leanok` has two positions: on a statement it means the signature is formalized, on the proof that the proof is. A sorry-bodied declaration under a statement-level `\leanok` is correct. Measuring all 1553 statement-level pins (964 resolvable) found 19 leaking `sorryAx` and zero with a proof-level `\leanok` — so the blueprint was not overclaiming, and my "fix" would have asserted something false. Reverted; reasoning in memory I-0406.
- `RiemannRoch/Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean` and four more sibling modules are on disk but untracked, so I did not root them — importing an untracked module breaks a clean checkout. ajc-rr and ajc-gate both notified.
- The campaign document's line-number citations had all drifted by tens of lines. Converted the load-bearing ones to declaration names and added a standing warning; I did not chase all of them.
- Parallel-run contention cost real time: a transient missing `.olean` from a sibling's rebuild, and `horizon roadmap set` applying partially (summary landed, `--owner`/`--pin-commit` silently dropped, twice). Recorded as memory I-0408.

## Why I stopped

Partly advanced, not complete — status left unset so it returns to the queue. The visibility criterion is met, but I-0372's rational-point decision is the human's and still open, and two of the five headline obligations (`Pic0.smooth`, `Pic0.proper`) belong to no current task.

## Next

- `Pic0.smooth` and `Pic0.proper` are the nearest unproved obligations under the headline and are unowned.
- Root the sibling modules once committed (a few lines each; they are not all below one entry point).
- `Curve/GeometricallyReduced.lean` is duplicated with the Rebuild project by file copy — an upstreaming candidate that would remove the duplication.
